rules.statement: The sale of a specific lot to the 5th Respondent by the 1st Respondent violated the Petitioner's fundamental rights and was null and void.
rules.supporting_quote: "For the foregoing reasons, we grant the Petitioner a declaration that the 1st Respondent, by the sale of Lot 1 in Plan No. 618 to the 5th Respondent, violated the petitioner's fundamental rights guaranteed by Article 12(1) of the Constitution."

meta.parties: Krishna Mining Co. (Ceylon) Ltd. v. Janatha Estates Development Board And
